easyPrerequisites: You do not control an Army.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lazotep Reaver, adding {C}{C}.
When Lazotep Reaver dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Lazotep Reaver from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Lazotep Reaver enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
